# fyre_vm_status (Data Source)

Fetches the current status of a Fyre VM. You must provide at least one identifier: vm_id, ip, or fqdn. The data source will try each non-null identifier until it successfully retrieves the VM status.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fqdn` (String) Fully Qualified Domain Name of the VM (must be in DNS). At least one of vm_id, ip, or fqdn must be provided.
- `ip` (String) IP address of the VM. At least one of vm_id, ip, or fqdn must be provided.
- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.
- `vm_id` (String) VM identifier (format: x-xxxxxxx). At least one of vm_id, ip, or fqdn must be provided.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier used to retrieve the VM status (same as the successful lookup field)
- `last_os_state` (String) The last known operating system state of the VM (e.g., running, stopped)
- `status` (String) Status message about any requests in progress
